**TL;DR:** Technology maintains sustained leadership, while Financials show fragility despite broad strength.

Technology continues to lead the market, being both all-green and sustained strong. Industrials and Real Estate also demonstrate broad strength, with Basic Materials emerging as a strong momentum leader.

Conversely, Consumer Cyclical remains the weakest sector by momentum, joined by Communication Services and Healthcare as significant laggards. Financials, while all-green, exhibit underlying fragility.

## Strength
*   4 of 11 groups are currently all-green, indicating broad positive performance across multiple timeframes.
*   Technology (momentum 0.77), Industrials (momentum 0.64), Financial (momentum 0.63), and Real Estate (momentum 0.60) are all-green.
*   Technology shows sustained strength, ranking in the top 3 across 1, 3, and 6-month periods.

## Movers & Momentum
*   Technology leads momentum with a score of 0.771, ranking 2nd YTD.
*   Basic Materials demonstrates strong momentum at 0.714, holding the 4th YTD rank.
*   Consumer Cyclical is the weakest momentum laggard at 0.171, ranking 11th YTD.
*   Communication Services (0.257) and Healthcare (0.329) also register as significant momentum laggards.

## Divergences
*   Financial is an all-green sector.
*   However, it exhibits fragility with an agreement score of 0.34.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Tech-related hardware and industrial sectors are demonstrating strong, sustained momentum, while several consumer-facing and healthcare industries are lagging.

Computer Hardware (momentum 0.99), Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (momentum 0.97), and Electronics & Computer Distribution (momentum 0.91) are leading the market with robust, sustained performance. Industrial sectors like Steel (momentum 0.90) and Metal Fabrication (momentum 0.86) also show significant strength.

Conversely, industries such as Broadcasting (0.055), Pharmaceutical Retailers (0.091), and Mortgage Finance (0.134) are fading, exhibiting very low momentum. Software - Application (0.113) and Medical Devices (0.172) also remain significant laggards.

## Strength
*   46 of 144 groups are all-green, indicating broad positive performance.
*   Computer Hardware (momentum 0.99), Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (momentum 0.97), and Electronics & Computer Distribution (momentum 0.91) are top all-green performers.
*   Steel (momentum 0.90), Metal Fabrication (momentum 0.86), REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.82), and Trucking (momentum 0.79) also show sustained strength.

## Movers & Momentum
*   Computer Hardware (0.993), Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (0.965), and Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.910) are the strongest momentum leaders.
*   Steel (0.904) and Metal Fabrication (0.859) also exhibit high momentum scores.
*   Mortgage Finance (0.134), Pharmaceutical Retailers (0.091), and Broadcasting (0.055) are among the weakest momentum laggards.
*   Software - Application (0.113) and Medical Devices (0.172) also show very low momentum.

## Divergences
*   Semiconductors are flagged as "Fragile all-green" with an agreement of 0.47, suggesting potential instability despite positive signals.
